content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Each of these platforms offers a unique set of features, but they all share one thing in common: they're built on top of existing infrastructure, which means you're trading control for convenience, but when you need to own your data and payments, you're left with limited choices, whereas sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you the tools to build a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, without relying on any third-party platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries, but this still leaves a significant number of countries without access, and a PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, making it difficult for creators in restricted countries to rely on these platforms, whereas sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be independent of any single platform or country, allowing you to collect payments and deliver products without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
You can't collect payments or deliver products without infrastructure sovereignty.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you need a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear choice, especially with options like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, for a one-time fee of $197, deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff, making it a reliable and cost-effective option for digital creators.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Platforms like Stripe and PayPal charge significant fees and hold funds for extended periods.

If you're interested in learning more about sovereign commerce infrastructure, check out our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where you can find options like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), designed to help digital creators like you build a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: Deploy your online store with Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, set up automatic payment processing with NOWPayments, automate delivery with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC with Supabase or Google Sheets, and test your infrastructure end-to-end before handoff, all of which can be done with the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, and 30-day support.
